Evidence Excerpt: Cumming, Warren County: Diligent Development of West Des Moines will create a mixed-use building with 32 apartments, 16 garages and ground-floor retail in Middlebrook, Iowa's first agrihood and an extension of the city's historic downtown.
Review Notes: Ground Breaker Homes' about page says Diligent Development is a sister company and that Kalen Ludwig is one of the owners of Ground Breaker Homes. That page does not say she owns Diligent, so she is not recorded as this company's owner. Ground Breaker itself has a published owner email and phone but no separate dated company event in this pass, so it is not its own signal row.
